prompt: Translate this friendly message for a close colleague into Basque: 'Hi, I will be about ten minutes late because traffic is slow. See you soon.'
expected: Uses casual peer zu register, preserves the ten-minute delay and traffic reason, and avoids forced hika or dense dialect.
actual: Kaixo, trafikoa motel dabil, beraz hamar minutu inguru beranduago iritsiko naiz. Laster ikusiko gara!

prompt: Write a Basque email to an unfamiliar university administrator asking whether the application deadline is still 15 May.
expected: Uses respectful formal zu/batua register, asks the factual question clearly, and excludes peer slang, fillers, and heavy code-switching.
actual: Egun on. Jakin nahi nuke ea eskaerak aurkezteko epea oraindik maiatzaren 15a den. Eskerrik asko aldez aurretik.

prompt: Rewrite this Basque social caption for a mixed audience: 'This coffee shop is very good, come visit us today.'
expected: Uses a neutral-warm batua promotional register suitable for a mixed audience without assuming intimate hika with every reader.
actual: Kafetegi hau benetan ona da — gaur etorri gurekin!
